title: 使用 AI 构建并发布全栈移动应用
author: Beau Carnes
content:
Building a production-ready mobile application used to require a dedicated team of frontend, backend, and DevOps engineers. With modern AI tools, an individual developer can take an idea from concept to the App Store.

In a comprehensive new tutorial published on the freeCodeCamp.org YouTube channel, you will learn how to build and publish CodexGram, a full-featured, Instagram-style social media application. Moving well beyond superficial "vibe coding," this course emphasizes deliberate planning, reproducible design prompting, robust backend integration, and strict adherence to App Store review standards.

CodexGram is built using Expo (React Native) and TypeScript, styled with NativeWind (Tailwind CSS for React Native) and Expo’s liquid-glass Native Tabs. Key features include:

  • Authentication
    Google and Apple sign-in powered by Clerk.

  • Real-Time Backend & Storage
    A reactive database, image uploads, and live updates using Convex.

  • Core Social Feed
    Photo uploads, captions, like/unlike toggles, threaded comments, and 24-hour stories with tap-to-advance and hold-to-pause interactions.

  • Direct Messaging & Explore
    Real-time 1-on-1 chats and a responsive grid for user discovery.

  • Production Observability
    Crash tracking, structured logging, and in-app user feedback via Sentry.

  • Legal & Marketing Site
    A responsive landing page, terms of service, and privacy policy deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

Watch the full course on the freeCodeCamp.org YouTube channel (3-hour watch).
aiSummary: 本教程演示了如何使用 Expo、TypeScript 和 Convex 构建并部署功能完备的社交媒体应用 CodexGram，重点关注 AI 辅助开发工作流。
oneSentenceSummary: 本教程演示了如何使用 Expo、TypeScript 和 Convex 构建并部署功能完备的社交媒体应用 CodexGram，重点关注 AI 辅助开发工作流。
summary: 本文提供了一份构建生产级社交媒体应用 CodexGram 的全面技术指南。涵盖了全栈技术，包括 Expo (React Native)、TypeScript、用于样式的 NativeWind 以及用于实时后端服务的 Convex。实现的核心功能包括通过 Clerk 进行身份验证、带有点赞和评论的社交动态、交互式快拍以及即时私信。作者强调要通过深思熟的规划、可重复的 AI 提示词以及通过 Sentry 观测性来满足 App Store 的提交要求，从而超越简单的“感性编程（vibe coding）”。

mainPoints.point: 该项目采用了现代移动开发全栈架构。
mainPoints.explanation: 通过使用 Expo 处理前端和 Convex 处理实时后端，开发者可以管理实时动态和消息等复杂的社交功能，而无需传统的开销。

mainPoints.point: 重点从简单的“感性编程”转向了严谨的工程实践。
mainPoints.explanation: 教程主倡深思熟虑的规划和可重复的 AI 提示词，以确保生成的代码具有维护性且符合生产标准，而不仅仅是在演示中可用。

mainPoints.point: 从零实现了全面的社交媒体功能。
mainPoints.explanation: 该指南涵盖了复杂的 UI/UX 模式构建，例如 24 小时快拍、线程化评论和实时私信系统。

mainPoints.point: 通过可观测性工具解决了生产就绪问题。
mainPoints.explanation: 引入 Sentry 进行崩溃跟踪和结构化日志记录，确保应用在发布到 App Store 后仍能够进行维护。

keyQuotes: 构建一个生产级的移动应用过去需要一个专门的前端、后端和 DevOps 工程师团队。有了现代 AI 工具，单个开发者就可以将创意从概念变为 App Store 中的应用。
远超肤浅的『感性编程』，这门课程强调深思熟虑的规划、可重复的设计提示词以及对 App Store 提交要求的满足。
